result.edit: The public test fails when checking the output value against expected in configuration 0 (M_N=87, c89=24, div_e=8, div_o=9). The failure shows the output is 1 when expected to be 0 at count=4, cycle=8, mode=1. The issue is in the even-period comparison where div_e is shifted right by 2 (div_e>>2) instead of 1 as specified. Changing to div_e>>1 matches the public waveform contract which requires floor(div_e/2)+1 for even periods (equivalent to div_e>>1+1). This will make the output match the expected value in all test cases.
